sn48.23:1.3: Found at [dn33:1.10.111]() and [iti62:2.3](), this went on to become a standard set in later Theravāda. | “The faculty of understanding that one’s enlightenment is imminent” is literally, “The faculty aware that ‘I shall know the unknown’.” | The verses at [iti162]() help explain the meaning; see notes there for a detailed discussion. In brief, I disagree with the traditional interpretation, and think the three faculties apply to: (1) one on the path to arahantship; (2) one on the occasion of realizing arahantship; (3) one living as an arahant.
